newsitem.title: USA: KV Pharmaceutical enters Roche deal.
newsitem.headline: KV Pharmaceutical enters Roche deal.

text.p: KV Pharmaceutical Co said on Monday that it has entered a broad-based agreement with Switzerland's Roche Holding Ltd.

KV said it will get licensing and marketing rights to Roche's vaginal antifungal product, cash payments to KV, drug delivery rights for three additional products, generic marketing rights for two Roche brand name products and the Roche's purchase of $3.5 million of KV's common stock.

KV Pharmaceutical said the agreement provides for the marketing by Roche or its licensee in the prescription of a one-dose cure vaginal antifungal product that uses KV's drug delivery technology. Approval for this product is in "its advanced stages," KV said.
The agreement provides for an initial cash payment of $3 million on January 1, 1997 and two additional payments of $3 million annually through January 1, 1999, KV said.
KV will manufacture the product and receive royalties once it is marketed, it said.
